decisions.reason: The No finiteness remark incorrectly makes finite generation necessary for invertible twists. Degree-one charts cover Proj for a degree-one generated algebra, even with infinitely many generators, and multiplication by x^n trivializes each twist on D_+(x). The relative assertion follows on affine-base restrictions. This is a nonfatal explanatory-remark defect: the construction and Definition are sound and unchanged.

The final remark promises a cohomological characterization, but thm-serre-criterion-ampleness states and proves eventual global generation of coherent twists on Noetherian schemes. It also contains no remark recording the arbitrary qcqs version. Corrected both unsupported pointers and the corresponding contract explanation. This nonfatal citation-scope error does not alter the affine-nonvanishing definition or any proof of it.

The remark correctly starts with qc morphism plus qc base implies qc source, but its conclusion that the definition applies to quasi-compact X suggests the invalid converse. Let A=k[x_1,x_2,...] and glue two copies of Spec A along W=union D(x_i). The base is a union of two qc affines and the first chart is qc, but its inclusion pulls the second chart back to W, which is not qc: for any finite index set F the prime (x_i:i in F) lies in W and outside every D(x_i) with i in F. Clarified the implication without altering the correct morphism hypothesis in the Definition. This is a nonfatal misleading remark, not a defect in the defined notion.

reviews.reason: Checked the entire Definition, affine-local gluing lemma, twist convention, associated-sheaf restriction interface, owning contract and page. For V=Spec C inside U=Spec R, localization and scalar extension commute degreewise, including shifted degree zero; restriction maps send fractions to identical fractions, so the twists and structural morphisms glue. Repaired only the false finiteness remark using degree-one chart frames. No new AC assumption or Definition change; this is author verification of the repair, not independent rejudgment.

Checked the Definition, nonvanishing-locus argument, empty case, owning contract, page and cited Serre theorem. In a local frame the fibre value is nonzero exactly when its coefficient is a unit; a germ inverse extends locally, proving openness. Quasi-compactness and one affine positive-power locus per point are exactly the cited Stacks definition. The empty scheme satisfies both conditions. Only the final remark and its contract explanation needed repair; the Definition and AC scope remain unchanged. This records my repair check, not an independent judgment.

Checked the entire Definition, Remarks, standard-chart supplier, proper-source/separated-target and closed-image interfaces, owning contract and page. The frames satisfy e_i=(t_i/t_j)e_j and the triple cocycle, so they define O(1) with the prescribed coordinate sections. Multiplication by x_i identifies the affine Proj twist with that frame. The definition explicitly requires qc f and qc immersion and permits n=0; the properness chain licenses closedness. Clarified only the qc-source remark and checked the final TeX arrow after correcting an escape typo. No Definition change or new AC use. This is verification of my repair, not independent review.
